name: player_reset_terrain_contact_impulses_and_play_impact_sfx
description: Player::ResetTerrainContactImpulsesAndPlayImpactSfx clears terrain angular impulses and starts the local landing impact loop sound with volume derived from vertical impact speed.
known_limits: tier S verification is deferred to the Player environment-probe surface-fit pass so local-player sound call shape and x87 clamp comparisons can be compared with the terrain tilt caller.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x42cb50 validates zeroing pitch/roll angular velocity, local-player gating, impact volume as abs(projectileSpawnVel.y * 0.1), clamp to 0..1, and StartModalLoopSfxHandle mode 5.
The native terrain smoke verifies the angular impulse reset on the nonlocal path, and the modal-loop smoke covers the delegated sound handle behavior.
